title: UI Branch Items
description: Computed: every component, stylesheet, CSS and JS item a branch shows that the requesting user may read, each marked own, inherited (from which branch) or packaged, with its content and its conflict. Read-only.

branch.description: The branch, as its URL names it (a name, optionally @pinned).

applies_to.description: A stylesheet's: the context it applies to ("": everywhere).

origin.description: own: the branch's row; inherited: an ancestor's; packaged: an installed UI layer's.

from.description: The branch whose row it is; null for a packaged item.

href.description: The item's resource; null for a packaged item and for an ancestor's item read from a pinned version.

etag.description: Its ETag, quoted as a header carries it.

conflict.description: An own item's conflict: listed by a pull (parent), or with a packaged layer item it overrides (layer).
